python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,copy
s=json.load(open('spec.vl.json'))
spec=s.pop('spec'); s.pop('facet'); s.pop('resolve'); s.pop('spacing')
s['title']['subtitle']="Aligned on release, the cycles collapse into two templates: interim releases get ~6 months of development and 9 months of support (18 months before 13.04), while LTS releases get 5 years of standard support, ESM to 10 years (since 12.04) and legacy support to 15 years (since 14.04)."
spec['height']={'step':14}
for l in spec['layer']:
    leg=l['encoding'].get('color',l['encoding'].get('shape'))['legend']; leg['labelLimit']=400
views=[]
for t in ['LTS releases','Interim releases']:
    v=copy.deepcopy(spec)
    v['transform']=[{'filter':f"datum.type == '{t}'"}]
    v['title']={'text':t,'anchor':'start','fontSize':14}
    v['encoding']['y']['title']=f"{t.split()[0]} release (by release date)"
    views.append(v)
views[0]['layer'][0]['encoding']['x']['title']=None
s['vconcat']=views; s['spacing']=18
json.dump(s,open('spec.vl.json','w'),indent=1)
EOF
render spec.vl.json

content.text:
I've saved the chart to `/work/spec.vl.json`. It renders with no errors or warnings.

Once the releases are lined up on their release dates, the life cycles fall into two clear patterns:

- **Interim releases:** about 6 months of development, then 18 months of support before 13.04 and 9 months from 13.04 on.
- **LTS releases:** 5 years of standard support for every LTS. 6.06–10.04 had 3 years for desktop, with server support running to 5 years. From 12.04 on, ESM runs to 10 years. From 14.04 on, legacy support runs to 15 years.

The chart has two panels, LTS above and interim below, sharing one horizontal axis in years.

```
REPORT
deliverable: spec.vl.json
requirements:
  R1: done - one row per release labelled by version, sorted by release date within each panel
  R2: done - x = years relative to own release date, axis title "Years relative to the release date (0 = release)"
  R3: done - development/standard/extended server/ESM/legacy bars, one colour each with a legend; missing phases not drawn
  R4: done - created = circle, release = diamond, with a shape legend
  R5: done - separate stacked panels for LTS and interim releases
  R6: done - title plus a one-sentence caption (subtitle, wrapped over two lines)
assumptions:
  - Years = days / 365.25
  - ESM starts at the later of eol and eol-server
  - Release type: "LTS" in the version string
  - Missing trailing CSV fields are treated as no date
limitations:
  - Planned (future) dates look the same as past dates
  - The release marker sits at 0 on every row, so it is the same on all rows by construction
  - Rows are sorted by release date within each panel, not across both panels together
```
